integrity: Proof is analytic; executable finite checks corroborate but do not certify all dimensions or parameters. No independent audit or validation has been conducted.
scientific_limitations: Uniform nearest-neighbor finite ring only; symmetric stationary single global random-telegraph Peierls phase with positive switching rate and a localized independent initial state. The exponential exponent is an eventual long-time return-probability exponent, not a proven finite-error mixing-time law. Independent publication-priority review remains necessary.
title: Arithmetic parity protection and quartic relaxation in a telegraph-flux quantum ring
